technical_data.additional_notes: Despite passing SPF, DKIM, and DMARC checks, the domain is newly registered and unrelated to any known recruitment agency associated with the target organization, raising suspicion of impersonation.

indicators: Sender IP 203.0.113.78 not recognized in corporate allowlist
Domain talentbridgeoutsourcing.net registered less than 4 months ago
Email requests sensitive employee tax documents via attachment
Base64 encoded URL parameter in email body to evade detection
Mismatch between sender's claimed organization and legitimate recruitment agencies
samples.detection_method: Combine domain age and IP reputation checks with attachment scanning; detect base64 encoded parameters in URLs; monitor for unsolicited requests for sensitive employee documents; user training to verify unexpected requests through direct contact.
relevant_mitre_techniques: T1589.004 - Gather Victim Identity Information: Personal Websites
